data.long_meaning: The name Blackwell is of Old English origin, derived from the words 'blac' meaning black and 'well' meaning a spring or well. Historically, the name was given to someone who lived near a black spring or well. In a Christian context, the name could symbolize the deep spiritual well of faith and devotion to God.
